continuity: The President's Security Service is temporarily protecting Jin and his family while closely observing him.
Jin has learned from Go Se-won that another secret area exists inside Area A of Ares Guild headquarters, but he has withheld the information until after Kim Hwajong's funeral.
At the national funeral, Jin and Team Leader Choi mourn Kim Hwajong, whose name is engraved on the memorial stele while his cremated remains are buried elsewhere.
Go Se-won's testimony has exposed extensive corruption and crimes within Ares Guild, triggering investigations of its executives and flight attempts by overseas branch directors.
The January 19 Incident caused 538 casualties and twenty deaths, with Go Jun's security team identified among the dead.
Public opinion strongly favors Jin and the Peace Guild, while Ares Guild and Lee Jungryong remain targets of condemnation.
Cheon Taemin has not appeared during the recent crises, and his whereabouts remain unknown.
plot: On the way home from his private meeting with Go Se-won, Jin Taekyung realizes that the A-rank Hunters from the President's Security Service suspect that something was discussed during their brief conversation. He decides to conceal Go Se-won's revelation about another secret area until after Kim Hwajong's funeral, both to spare Team Leader Choi and to give himself time to process it.

A week after the January 19 Incident, Go Se-won's testimony has plunged Ares Guild into its worst crisis since its founding, while Jin Taekyung and the Peace Guild receive widespread public support. The media reports that the incident caused 538 casualties but only twenty deaths, most of them Go Jun's security team, and that Cheon Taemin has still not appeared despite the continuing turmoil surrounding Ares Guild.

At the national funeral for the victims, Jin visits the National Cemetery and finds Kim Hwajong's name on the memorial stele. Team Leader Choi joins him and says that Butler Kim will rest peacefully, but that they will be even busier from then on; Jin realizes it is time to tell Choi what he has kept hidden.

Public opinion strongly supports Jin and the Peace Guild, while Ares Guild and Lee Jungryong face condemnation.
Cheon Taemin remains absent despite the Arc Lich crisis, Lee Jungryong's national funeral, and the destruction of Ares Guild headquarters, leaving his whereabouts unknown.
